# Jordan Hale
Product-minded software engineer · Portland, Oregon · jordan.hale@example.com · (503) 555-0148

## Summary
Software engineer with six years of experience building accessible web applications for hiring teams and internal tools. Focused on Angular front ends, typed APIs, and clear writing. Looking for a role that mixes product sense with hands-on TypeScript.

## Experience

### Senior Software Engineer, Northwind Talent
March 2022 – Present · Portland, Oregon
- Led a redesign of the applicant review screen, cutting the median time to complete a review from 14 minutes to 9 minutes across 80 recruiters.
- Rebuilt the resume intake form in Angular, replacing a multi-page flow with one screen and raising successful submissions from 62% to 81%.
- Added keyboard support and screen-reader labels to the review queue, clearing 12 open accessibility bugs before a customer audit.
- Partnered with design to ship a shared component library used by 4 product teams.

### Software Engineer, Lumenfield
June 2019 – February 2022 · Remote
- Shipped a scheduling assistant that booked 1,200 interviews in its first quarter and reduced coordinator back-and-forth email by 35%.
- Wrote integration tests for the hiring API and brought the nightly failure rate from 8% to under 1%.
- Mentored two new engineers through their first production releases.

## Projects
- Open-source checklist for accessible data tables, used as a teaching example in three local meetups.
- A small CLI that converts plain-text job descriptions into a structured outline for recruiters.

## Education
B.S. Computer Science, Oregon State University, 2019

## Skills
TypeScript, Angular, accessibility, technical writing, REST APIs, testing
